items.name: Valve Steam Frame
items.dateText: Summer 2026, packaging finished, no date or price yet
items.summary: Valve's standalone SteamOS headset with a dedicated 6GHz wireless dongle for PC streaming. The FCC granted equipment authorization for FCC ID 2AES4-1015 on July 29 and the hardware has cleared customs. Valve's own unboxing and first-time-setup videos leaked out of the Steam client on August 19, showing retail packaging and the Ergonomic Accessories Kit. The Great on Frame catalog has grown from eight certified titles on July 17 to 89 on August 24. Valve has still named neither a price nor a release date, and summer ends September 22.

items.name: Samsung Galaxy XR (UK launch)
items.summary: Samsung's flagship Android XR headset reached the UK with the Explorer Pack software bundle. It launched in the US and Korea in November 2025 at $1,799.

items.name: Pico Space Pro
items.dateText: September 2, 2026 Beijing debut, retail date TBA
items.summary: Project Swan is now Pico Space Pro, debuting in Beijing on September 2, three weeks before Meta Connect. The claimed sheet is 4,000 PPI micro-OLED, dual-chip compute at 12ms perception latency, and 270 grams. Nobody outside Pico has seen the hardware, and a debut event is not a retail date.

items.name: Vivo Vision
items.summary: Vivo's 398 gram headset with dual 8K-class micro-OLED displays runs its own OriginOS Vision rather than Android XR, deepening the platform split in China.

items.name: Meta Quest 4
items.summary: Meta's next gaming flagship, codename Griffin, is reported for the second half of 2027, with a separate ultralight tethered headset also on the roadmap. Nothing ships in 2026.

items.name: XREAL AURA
items.dateText: Fall 2026, two of three reservation tiers sold out
items.price: No more than $1,500 for the base model, per XREAL, before tax
items.summary: XREAL's Android XR glasses have passed 10,000 reservations. The $299 Founder Priority Pass sold out its 2,000 units in 36 hours and the $99 Launch Credit tier is gone, leaving the refundable $199 Priority Deposit. XREAL's FAQ now caps the $1,500 ceiling to the base configuration only, and the launch region list has grown to 28 entries while quietly dropping Canada.

items.name: Snap Specs
items.summary: Snap's standalone true AR glasses with a 51 degree field of view and 4 million Lenses at launch. Preorders opened at AWE with a $200 refundable deposit. Snap has now set a full launch event for September 16 in Los Angeles, where Evan Spiegel gives the first in-depth look and attendees go hands-on. A ship date has still not been named.

items.name: Google x Warby Parker Android XR glasses
items.summary: The first consumer Android XR glasses from Google's Warby Parker partnership, announced on stage at I/O for the US, UK, and Canada.

items.name: Google Pixel Buds Sight
items.summary: Google's audio-first AI glasses, announced at I/O 2026 as the affordable entry point into the Android XR glasses lineup.

items.name: Samsung Intelligent Eyewear (Jinju)
items.dateText: Named at Unpacked July 22, no price or ship date
items.summary: Samsung's display-free AI glasses, confirmed by name at Galaxy Unpacked on July 22 after leaking through One UI firmware. About 50 grams on a Snapdragon AR1. Samsung announced the name and almost nothing else: no price, no ship date, no SDK.

items.name: Gentle Monster Android XR glasses
items.summary: The fashion-forward arm of Google's Android XR glasses push, announced at I/O with a softer target than the Warby Parker launch.

items.name: Samsung Galaxy Glasses (Haean display model)
items.summary: Samsung's display glasses slipped to mid-2027, a delay Sundar Pichai confirmed on stage at I/O 2026.

items.name: Apple smart glasses
items.summary: Display-free AI glasses reportedly in testing across four frame designs, with a possible unveil alongside the iPhone 18 and sales in 2027. Apple has confirmed nothing.

items.name: Acer AR Vision GR0
items.summary: Acer's return to XR: tethered display glasses with dual 1080p micro-OLED panels, announced at Computex 2026.

items.name: Cave Crave
items.dateText: Out now on Quest and PSVR2
items.summary: A claustrophobic cave-systems simulator from 3R Games, with crawling, climbing and squeeze-through-tight-gaps traversal. Shipped on Quest first and reached PSVR2 on July 10.

items.name: Amelia's Escape
items.dateText: Released July 23, 2026 on Quest and PC VR
items.summary: A VR escape room with an interwoven time travel narrative from solo developer Rupert Lawrence at Reality Syndrome Symphony. Play as Amelia and puzzle your way out of a time-travel-obsessed scientist's room. Launched July 23 on Quest and SteamVR at $15.99.

items.name: Guardians Planetfall (SteamVR version)
items.summary: The RTS-shooter hybrid is out now on Quest, with the SteamVR version now targeting Q4 2026 early access rather than the summer window originally given.

items.name: Transformers: Beyond Reality Redux
items.summary: The rebuilt Transformers VR shooter, dated at the Summer 2026 VR Games Showcase.

items.name: The Lightkeepers
items.summary: A day/night lighthouse defense co-op game, announced with a firm date at the Summer 2026 VR Games Showcase.

items.name: Sol Protocol
items.dateText: September 17, 2026, Early Access on Quest 3 and 3S
items.price: $9.99 preorder, rising to $12.99 at full release
items.summary: Singular Perception's three-player co-op space roguelike. Pilot, gunner and engineer seats aboard the Pathfinder, with roles swapping mid-run through procedurally generated systems. SteamVR is targeted for October. The Automa systems meant to fill empty crew seats are still in development and are not a launch feature.

items.name: Already Dead
items.summary: A fixed-camera survival puzzler headed to PSVR2 this fall.

items.name: Hyperlane Highway
items.summary: A hoverboard roguelite with a Q4 window, wishlists live now.

items.name: Payday: Aces High
items.summary: Fast Travel Games' four-player co-op heist shooter, confirmed for 2026 and notable as the first game to list Steam Frame as a target platform. Press played the first heist job at an August 2026 media session; no date has been named.

items.name: Breachers: Outbreak
items.summary: Triangle Factory's four-player co-op zombie extraction spinoff of Breachers, announced at the Summer 2026 VR Games Showcase with no firm date yet.

items.name: Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars
items.summary: Maze Theory's mixed reality game with an original story written by Andy Weir, targeting later this year.

items.name: FNAF: Secret of the Mimic (Quest version)
items.summary: The Quest port of the Five Nights at Freddy's flat-to-VR hybrid is in development after the PSVR2 and PC VR releases this spring.

items.name: H3VR2 (Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades 2)
items.summary: The Meta-backed sequel to the beloved gun-sandbox, announced at the Creature Feature Showcase with no date or price.

items.name: Into the Radius 2 (Quest version)
items.summary: CM Games' survival shooter left Early Access on Quest on August 27, completing the 1.0 release after the PC VR launch in April. A PS VR2 version follows on September 24.

items.name: Steam Frame Enthusiast Kit
items.summary: An accessory bundle with a hot-swappable battery pack for the Steam Frame, confirmed by FCC filings in June.

items.name: Pimax Dream Air / Dream Air SE
items.dateText: Shipping now, preorder backlog clears by August 2026
items.price: Dream Air SE from $899; Dream Air from $1,999
items.summary: Pimax's compact micro-OLED PC VR headsets are reaching buyers, with Pimax committing to ship every outstanding preorder by August.

items.name: Cave Crave: Tham Luang expansion
items.dateText: Out now on Quest, PSVR2 and PC VR to follow
items.summary: A virtual reconstruction of Thailand's Tham Luang cave rescue, adding swimming and diving through fully submerged passages. Launched on Quest July 30, with PSVR2 and SteamVR still to come. Cave rescue divers John Volanthen and Vern Unsworth and cave-scanning expert Richard Walters contributed.

items.name: D.E.C.A.Y.
items.dateText: Early Access launched August 26, 2026 on SteamVR
items.summary: A post-nuclear survival shooter from AGaming+, the solo studio behind the Z.O.N.A. series. Players maintain the Atlas network of thermal and radiation shields, with bunker-based gear management in the vein of Into the Radius. Launched Early Access on August 26; full release is expected about a year out.

items.name: VITURE Pro 2
items.summary: Viture's lightest glasses yet at 63g, with a 146-inch virtual screen, 1920x1080 per eye at 120Hz, Sony micro-OLED panels rated 1,600 nits, and built-in 0 to -5.00D diopter adjustment. At $299 it is the cheapest credible entry in the display-glasses category.

items.name: Escape Simulator 2 (VR update)
items.dateText: Free VR update before end of 2026
items.summary: Pine Studio has a public VR preview running on Steam's open_beta branch with every official room playable. The full VR update ships free to existing owners before the end of 2026.

items.name: Into the Radius 2 (PS VR2 version)
items.summary: The PlayStation VR2 release of CM Games' survival shooter, announced on the PlayStation Blog for September 24, four weeks after the Quest version leaves Early Access.

items.name: RayNeo iO Smart Glasses
items.summary: A 33-gram camera-free waveguide HUD built for ambient AI rather than media, with a MicroLED display and a 23 degree field of view. Sold through RayNeo's own store and Amazon, with IFA demos in Hall 21A.

items.name: RayNeo GT and GT Max
items.summary: A 78-gram personal-cinema pair with dual 1080p 120Hz micro-OLED panels, a 59 degree field of view, dual-chip architecture and Bang & Olufsen quad speakers. The display half of RayNeo's deliberate split between a display device and an assistant device.
